3D Scanning Services in Brisbane — LiDAR, Photogrammetry & Drone Surveys

Atlantis NDT provides survey-grade 3D scanning and reality-capture services in Brisbane, combining LiDAR laser scanning, photogrammetry and drone-based (UAV) capture to turn plants, tanks, vessels, structures and components into accurate, measurable digital models.

Backed by our ASNT Level III inspection team, scans captured in Brisbane feed into as-built CAD, BIM and digital-twin workflows and support API 653 / API 510 tank and vessel deformation surveys, corrosion and coating mapping, clash detection, reverse engineering, and turnaround planning.
